about: SL8 default conventions for marketing-static-ad-production: batch layout, the global ad-set number, folder and file names, allocation and the batch record. A kit may put its own file with the same keys in a conventions folder (statics.mjs where --conventions <dir>); each key group is read from there first, then from this file. Values restated from the JuicyLucy workspace conventions and ad-naming tool (research juicylucy-ads/juicylucy-b90136, juicylucy-ads/adnaming-d7bdfd); the name patterns are SL8's own.

date.rule: From the intended publish day. An existing dated folder is reused only as a same-day continuation, and then nothing in it is changed, renumbered or reallocated: the new cycle is the next c<k>.

sequence.scope: Every folder and file name under the campaign root, at any depth, across every date, language and medium (a video batch on the same campaign shares the line).
sequence.reserve: Scan for the highest number immediately before the folders are created; take one contiguous block for ad sets x languages; nothing is locked, so a second session must re-scan.

fields.LL: the language code in capitals, the same token that leads every file name in the folder
fields.batch: a short descriptor of the concept or audience; no underscore
fields.ads: the number of distinct files the folder holds; a folder whose count changes is renamed

fields.concept: the concept name; no underscore and no ' - '
fields.mode: copy, visual or remix (the master's mutation mode)
fields.date: the batch date YYYY.MM.DD; a localized copy inherits it
fields.version: 1, then the next free number when the name already exists

file.inherit: A localized copy keeps everything after the first ' - ' byte for byte; only the leading language token changes.
file.never: Never type a file name, folder name or number by hand: statics.mjs writes them.

allocation.languages_per_campaign: ceil(min_ad_sets_per_active_campaign / ad sets per language): 1 -> 5, 2 -> 3, 3 -> 2, 4 -> 2, 5 or more -> 1
allocation.minimum: The figure is a floor per active campaign, not a ceiling; rounding up may give more ad sets.
allocation.coverage: Every campaign the customer's campaign structure marks active for new ads gets its share; a smaller requested total is corrected and reported in the allocation table, never met by leaving a campaign out.
allocation.ranking: Within a campaign, rank candidate languages by conversion volume and cost efficiency together: never one metric alone, never a cost per result from a single conversion.
allocation.fresh: Allocation reads the campaign structure and per-language results supplied for this run; an older export is never reused.

languages: marketing-ad-localization references/languages.json (codes, scripts, right-to-left flags); a code not in the table is confirmed before any folder or file uses it

batch_record.about: batch.json, one per cycle, written by the agent and read by statics.mjs history
fields: masters[{id, concept, mode, kept[], changed[], approved, languages[]}]

safe_zones.about: Percent of the frame kept clear of text and the logo, so a platform's own interface (profile bar, caption, buttons) does not cover them. Keys are ratios; a kit's conventions file may replace the group.

copy_file.about: work/<project>/<master id>.copy.json, read by scripts/compose.py. Boxes are [x, y, w, h] as percent of the frame and must sit inside safe_zones; sizes are percent of the frame width. Step 15 writes the same boxes into the prompt's calm zones.

fields.font: the brand's font file from the kit (fc-match confirms it); a line may name its own
fields.scrim: auto (a dark or light panel only where contrast would be under 4.5:1) or off
fields.lines: [{role: headline|proof|cta|brand, text, box, anchor: left|center|right, valign: top|middle|bottom, size_pct, min_size_pct, colour, max_lines, direction: ltr|rtl, language}]
fields.logo: {file (PNG; convert an SVG once), corner: top-left|top-right|bottom-left|bottom-right, width_pct (18), margin_pct (4); placed inside the safe area}

copy_file.rules: The headline is never set smaller than another line; every role present in the approved copy has a line; the logo box is the corner box the prompt kept empty (width_pct plus twice margin_pct wide, inside the safe area).
